entities.summary:
Soraya Munyana Hakuziyaremye is a Rwandan banker and financial management professional who has served as the Governor of the National Bank of Rwanda since 2021. A key figure in Rwanda's economic development, Soraya has been instrumental in shaping the country's financial sector and promoting economic growth.

Under her leadership, the National Bank of Rwanda has implemented several initiatives to promote financial inclusion and reduce poverty. Soraya has also been a strong advocate for gender equality in the financial sector, working to increase the representation of women in leadership positions.

Soraya's contributions to Rwanda's economic development have been recognized internationally, with her receiving several awards for her work in promoting financial inclusion and economic growth. She has also been a vocal advocate for Rwanda's integration into the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA).

Soraya's legacy extends beyond her work at the National Bank of Rwanda. She has been a role model for young Rwandans, inspiring a new generation of women to pursue careers in finance and economics.

As she continues to shape Rwanda's economic future, Soraya's impact will be felt for generations to come.
